title: Rethinking Learner Modeling: A Feedback-Centric Cognitive Disentanglement Perspective

problem.claim: Cognitive diagnosis aims to infer learners' mastery of specific knowledge concepts from practice behavior.

gap.claim: Existing studies generally do not explicitly disentangle multiple interdependent factors influencing learner response feedback during problem solving.

contributions.claim: DISCD is a feedback-centric disentangled cognitive diagnosis framework for effective and interpretable learner modeling.
A variational-inference-based disentangled encoder uses the interaction matrix and exercise-concept correlation matrix with three sub-encoders to characterize cognitive attributes.
The framework combines a multi-level cognitive coordination module with a cognitive interaction decoder for diagnosis decoding and reconstruction of engagement trajectories.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on four educational datasets are reported to validate DISCD's effectiveness for learner modeling in cognitive diagnosis.

narrative_sequence.summary: Online tutoring platforms use learner engagement behavior to support personalized learning.
Cognitive diagnosis infers knowledge mastery, but existing studies do not explicitly disentangle interdependent influences on response feedback.
DISCD introduces feedback-centric disentangled encoding, matrix-based signal extraction, and coordinated cognitive-factor modeling.
A cognitive interaction decoder reconstructs and refines learners' exercise engagement trajectories.
The authors report validation on four educational datasets.

source_observation.claim: The framework uses multiple matrices and dedicated sub-encoders to capture disentangled learner attributes.

interpretation.claim: Separating heterogeneous signals may improve the interpretability of learner modeling.

application.claim: When modeling learner behavior, consider explicit factorization of distinct response-related signals before prediction.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether disentanglement improves performance or interpretability across settings beyond the reported datasets.

unknowns: The four educational datasets are not identified.
Evaluation metrics, baselines, numerical results, and ablation findings are not provided.
The specific cognitive factors disentangled by the model are not enumerated.
Implementation details and reproducibility information are not provided.
